answer: Because the atlas release is published with every signature, the plume audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the glacier graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 4 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
